populations: full source population per unit mapping; fixture tenant is Tenant One for development evidence only
nondeterminism: exact match on row content after canonicalization; no drift allowance (cdc_lag_max_s=0, cdc_in_flight_max_rows=0); run-scoped keys (run ids, timestamps) must be pinned or canonicalized in the mapping spec
degraded_mode: not in effect; live recon required for merge eligibility. If live access is lost mid-run, the wave parks and degraded/snapshot evidence is recorded but never merges
amendment: tolerances change only through a plan.yaml decision selected by the human. Every amendment preserves the old row (append a new version, never edit in place) and names the re-verification scope (units/tiers re-run under the new value)
